title: fix(traces): stop the traces list scrollbar jumping

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review 1d422d49-98cf-4c2f-8993-8ebeed36ac68 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
Two-line keying change, contained to the traces list; keys are unique and the observer's added-node path is already there. The DOM-diff behaviour itself has no test.
<sub>no findings · tests partial −1 · risk medium</sub>

Keys the traces list's virtual rows plus its two spacers and the loading row, so a window shift adds new `tr` nodes for the virtualizer to measure instead of rewriting old ones. Contained to the traces list markup and safe to merge.

- `traceRow` keys each row `row-${index}`, following the logs stream's index keys
- `spacer` and the "Loading more" row carry their own keys, matching `agent-sessions/list/view-table.ts`

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `traceRow`'s only caller is `view-table.ts:161`, one row per `item.index`, so keys stay unique among tbody siblings
- New keys `spacer-before`/`spacer-after`/`loading-more` cannot collide with `row-${index}`; both `spacer` calls were updated (`view-table.ts:155`, `:169`)
- `virtualize.ts:83-91` measures only added `tr[data-index]` nodes and never patches in place, which is what keyed rows now produce

</details>

<sub>`492d6fb` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>
